notes: Controlled before/after comparison using the installed Nav2 planner server and inflation layer, with fixed start and goal on identical synthetic maps.
Clearance is measured from path centers to occupied grid-cell centers (5 cm resolution); not a guaranteed real-world wall clearance.
A 1.1 m corridor remains planable; physical traversal was not tested.
Robot geometry and hard inscribed collision boundary were not expanded; inflation outside that boundary remains traversable soft cost.
Controller inflation_cost_scaling_factor matched the local inflation layer.
